== Notes ==
* Recurring Insecurity only reapplies itself if it lasts its full [[duration]]. Therefore using a [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal skill]], such as [[Remove Hex]], will safely remove Recurring Insecurity without it being reapplied.
* Recurring Insecurity triggers [[Soul Barbs]] with each reapplication.
